observations: Wooden pallet(s) shown on a concrete floor (photo 0 and photo 1 show a single pallet).
Pallet has rectangular deck boards with cut-outs typical of standard shipping pallets.
Red/brown end boards visible; wood looks dry but worn.
Photo 2 shows multiple pallets stacked together.
No clear brand/model markings visible on the pallet itself; there is a watermark text overlay on the images.

claims.evidence: Photos show wooden pallets, but the exact pallet standard/size (e.g., 4-way entry, dimensions, ISPM treatment stamp) is not clearly readable.

risks.risk: Unclear pallet size/standard (could be non-standard dimensions or different entry style), affecting fit for your use and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure showing length x width x height, plus a shot of the underside/entry side to confirm 4-way entry.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used wooden pallets with unknown dimensions/standard.

risks.risk: Condition issues (broken boards, loose stringers, or damaged deck that may fail under load). Photos suggest wear but don’t confirm structural integrity.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all corners and underside stringers, and a short video showing a person lifting/pressing the deck to check for flex/broken boards.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets with possible minor damage (not guaranteed load-bearing).

risks.risk: Treatment/infestation risk (heat-treated vs chemically treated vs untreated; possible pests). Photos don’t show any stamp.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any stamp/mark on the pallet (e.g., IPPC/MB/HT marks) on at least two different boards.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untreated/unknown treatment risk (lower value).

risks.risk: Quantity ambiguity (photo 2 shows many pallets, but seller text doesn’t specify how many you will receive).
risks.proof: Confirm the exact number of pallets per purchase (or whether it’s per pallet or per stack) with a count or labeled stack photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price per single pallet only, unless quantity is confirmed.

proof_requests: Confirm whether the sale is per pallet or per bundle/stack, and the exact quantity you will deliver.
Provide pallet dimensions (L x W x H) with a tape measure in-frame.
Provide underside/entry-side photos to confirm entry style (4-way/2-way) and board/stringer condition.
Provide close-up photos of any treatment stamp/mark (IPPC/HT/MB) on the pallet.
response.reason: The photos clearly show wooden pallets, but key pricing drivers are missing remotely: exact quantity, pallet dimensions/standard, and condition/treatment stamps. Get those proofs before pricing confidently.
